canonical_selector.rule: This is the only current-work selector. DPL-01..14 and MAI-01..10 are completed_verified; AAI-01 is selected_not_started only.

work_state.rule: AAI-01-attempt-001 is the sole CURRENT application checkpoint and grants planning-resolution authority only. No implementation branch or provider integration authority exists until a future governed start freshly verifies current provider/API/terms/license/entitlement evidence.

active_work.implementation_scope: Selection/planning resolution only: future governed start must survey current local/user-owned audio and provider APIs/SDKs/terms/accounts/entitlement/license/capability evidence and establish fail-closed provider-neutral authority boundaries before implementation.
active_work.integration_requirement: Consume completed MAI provider-neutral interoperability patterns while preserving audio-intent/provider-asset separation, explicit source/license/entitlement/provenance evidence, unsupported capability states, manual/silence control and all World/Event/Combat/gameplay owner truths.

selection_invariants: MAI-01..10 completed_verified with exact evidence preserved and no further implementation authority.
AAI-01 selected_not_started with no implementation branch or authority.
Future AAI-01 start requires fresh current APIs, SDKs, terms, accounts, entitlement/license and capability evidence.
No provider or catalog is canonical and no provider is assumed to support every capability.
Audio intent and selected provider asset/reference remain separate.
Commercial provider audio is controlled or referenced rather than copied absent explicit license.
Unsupported, unavailable, unknown, entitlement-denied or license-restricted capability remains explicit rather than emulated by scraping or prohibited copying.
Audio remains presentation/support state and cannot replace World/Event/Combat/gameplay truth.
Missing or disabled audio never blocks play; hidden/GM-only cues remain permission-scoped.
Recording, streaming, caching, export, attribution and redistribution permissions are explicit capability/license decisions.
No provider acquisition/download/authentication/scraping/payment, production provider activation, real-money integration, tester distribution, release or deployment is authorized.
